content: <thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a reaction template that forms the C=C bond between the terminal methylene and the carbon bearing the phenyl ring. A typical way to make such a bond is a Suzuki‑Miyaura cross‑coupling of a vinyl halide (or vinyl triflate) with an aryl boronic acid. I will search the template catalog for forward reactions that break a C‑X bond (e.g., C‑Br) and form a C‑C bond between a vinyl carbon and an aryl carbon. This should give a suitable retrosynthetic template.
